protocol: FedBCert E23 frozen multi-safe-expert certificate cover
origin: E22a stopped under its original gates; E23 is a new independently confirmed construction and does not reinterpret E22a

components.feature_ce: graph-invariant feature safe expert trained with labels only
components.feature_kd_cad: graph-invariant feature safe expert trained with CE, KD and CAD
components.spectral_cad: endpoint-blind bounded spectral safe expert trained with CE and CAD

cover_rule: certify with feature_kd_cad when it agrees with the teacher; otherwise certify with spectral_cad when it is completion-certified and agrees; otherwise use the uncertified teacher
prohibited_actions: changing component models, losses, cover order or thresholds after any E23 test result
selecting a component or routing rule per dataset
recomputing the cover after revealing a completion
certifying nodes outside the frozen union
dropping feature_ce or either single-safe-expert comparator
